title: Nonlinear Meissner States, Vortex Sheets, and Laminar Structures in Extreme Type-II Superconductors
summary: A recently derived nonlinear velocity theory of extreme type-II superconductors is shown to possess an exactly solvable one-dimensional sector. Its solutions include nonlinear Meissner states exhibiting universal tails, vortex sheets, and periodic laminar structures. The thermodynamic critical field emerges from a marginal Meissner profile equivalent to the normal-superconducting boundary and may be viewed as a half-soliton.
